_comment: Arrhenius parameters (A in s^-1, Ea in J/mol) and a stated TGA onset temperature of the thermal decomposition of solids. STATUS: every row is `recalled` - written from memory, attributed to the references below, and NOT checked against them (the tables and pages that an earlier version of this file cited were not opened). The stated onsets are not reproduced by the stated Arrhenius parameters for most rows (a first-order model at 10 K/min gives T(5 %) 20-300 K away; see the unit test in engine/src/gem/rates.rs), so treat each row as tier Speculative until it is replaced by a value read from a source. Used by engine/src/gem/rates.rs (Section 13.2 of rates-from-data-plan.md); the engine also stops a decomposition at its thermodynamic equilibrium, so a too-fast rate only matters above that temperature.
